payload.expected_edge: The prospectively defined mechanism may continue; exploratory exercise cannot establish whether that expectation is correct.
expected_failure_modes: reclaim is a pause before downside continuation
modeled costs and adverse selection exceed any gross effect
invalidation_conditions: downside excursion below 0.25 times breakdown-bar ATR20
breakdown close does not finish below the opening-range low
adjacent bar does not close strictly back inside the opening range
known_risks: reclaim is a pause before renewed downside continuation
opening-range midpoint remains unreachable after entry
modeled costs exceed any gross effect
payload.market_assumption: A downside opening-range excursion can be a temporary liquidity probe when the immediately adjacent bar closes back inside the range.
payload.mechanism: The downside break can trap breakout participants; an adjacent reclaim with ordinary-or-greater same-clock participation tests a move toward the frozen opening-range midpoint.
required_evidence: twenty prior eligible same-clock volume observations
required_indicators: five-minute opening-range high, low, and midpoint
same-clock volume median over twenty prior eligible sessions
payload.title: Five-minute opening-range failed downside breakout reclaim
